200.html:
data

[object]

List of Elastic Cloud CCM accounts.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of an Elastic Cloud CCM (Cloud Cost Management) account. The configuration is hoisted directly onto the attributes; there is no interface wrapper because the elastic-cloud-ccm interface is fixed by the endpoint path.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication methods supported by the Elastic Cloud CCM interface. Exactly one is set, selected by its type.

<type=bearer_token>

object

Encrypted token (bearer token) authentication for Elastic Cloud CCM.

api_key [required]

string

Billing API key. An Elastic Cloud API key with read access to both Billing and Deployments. Create one under Organization settings > API Keys. This field is not returned by the API.

type [required]

enum

Authentication method discriminator. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

dataflows

[object]

Dataflows for the Elastic Cloud CCM interface.

enabled

boolean

Whether the dataflow is enabled.

id [required]

enum

Identifier of an Elastic Cloud CCM dataflow. Allowed enum values: elastic-cloud-cost-data

status

object

Read-only, server-computed collection status of a dataflow.

health

enum

Collection health of a single dataflow. Allowed enum values: DATAFLOW_HEALTH_OK,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_BROKEN,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_UNKNOWN

message

string

Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.

updated_at

date-time

Time the status was last computed.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the account.

permissions

object

Read-only permission information for the account, derived from its restriction policy.

resource_id

string

Restriction-policy resource identifier of this account.

user_can_edit

boolean

Whether the requesting user may edit this account.

settings

object

Elastic Cloud CCM interface settings.

elastic_org_id [required]

string

Your Elastic Cloud organization ID, found in your organization settings.

id [required]

string

Server-generated unique identifier of the integration account.

type [required]

enum

JSON:API resource type for an integration account. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
